description: This file defines the 'AdvancedValueBinder' class in the PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Cell namespace, which extends default value binding behavior for spreadsheet cells. It implements custom logic for binding various data types such as strings, fractions, percentages, currencies, times, and dates to spreadsheet cells, including style formatting. The class leverages multiple other components in the PhpSpreadsheet library for calculations, formatting, and shared utilities.

classes.name: AdvancedValueBinder
classes.description: A class that extends DefaultValueBinder to provide advanced logic for binding values to spreadsheet cells with proper formatting and type detection.

methods.name: bindValue
methods.description: Main method to bind a given value to a cell, handling various data types including strings, booleans, fractions, percentages, currencies, times, and dates with appropriate styles.

methods.name: setImproperFraction
methods.description: Handles binding of improper fractions, converting them into numeric values and setting the appropriate number format.

methods.name: setProperFraction
methods.description: Handles binding of proper fractions, converting them into numeric values and setting format mask.

methods.name: setPercentage
methods.description: Converts a percentage string to a numeric value and applies percentage formatting.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets a numeric value as currency with the specified currency code.

methods.name: setTimeHoursMinutes
methods.description: Converts a time (hours:minutes) string into a numeric value representing days and applies a date-time format.

methods.name: setTimeHoursMinutesSeconds
methods.description: Converts a time with seconds into a numeric value representing days and applies a date-time format.
